name: Frigate Type (Test) - New Ship Type 15
description: Test mod: adds the Frigate (FF) as a true new ship type number, 15. The designer's Ship type list gains FF - Frigate; frigates are saved as ShipType=FF and show FF on the ship window, lists and news. The game's rules, AI, battle and campaign code treat a frigate as a corvette (KE), except that a corvette is limited to 200-8,000 t and a frigate is 1,500-12,000 t; both may carry torpedoes from 1950. Auto design makes a frigate from the AI's destroyer design. A frigate's ship picture uses the destroyer's (DD) hull outline and proportions. Expanded Timeline's KE-to-FF rename is off while this runs. Experimental; use a separate test campaign. Details: Mods/Manager/FRIGATE_TYPE.md.
